# `network/chunks/SwarmScheduler.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/chunks/SwarmScheduler.js`

network/chunks/SwarmScheduler.js — spread chunk fetches across multiple providing peers (network plan §31 swarm fetching). Pure scheduling logic; the actual byte transfer happens over routes/sessions from earlier phases.

## Functions

### `planSwarmFetch({ chunkIds, providers, maxLanes = 4 } = {})`

Assign each requested chunk to one candidate provider peer, load-balancing so no single peer is asked for every chunk, then group the assignments into fetch "lanes" of up to `maxLanes` concurrent requests.

**Parameters:**

- `c` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `c.chunkIds` *(string[])* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `c.providers` *(Map<string,string[]>)* — chunkId -> candidate peerIds (network plan §31 provider records)
- `[c.maxLanes]` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** >, lanes:Array<Array<{chunkId:string, peerId:string}>>, unresolved:string[], peerLoad:object }}
